subject: P06
required_fixes: P06-R3-F1 (medium): Preserve admitted, unsent messages through the final durable save, including successful export completion. In crates/desktop-core/src/harness/session.rs:1036-1037, finish_export saves a valid export before adding the deferred message; save clears unsaved at :1055. launched then computes turn_open=false at :524 and only afterward appends the failed operator entry (:527-539). With no streaming entries, :591-595 skips the final save. The screen shows the unsent message and a successful savedAt, but offline history omits that message. The new stop accounting also consumes and discards deferred Command::Renew, which carries the same operator prompt (authority/harness_domain.rs:660-665), because :527 matches only Send. A Send admitted into the command channel can likewise disappear if cancellation wins before commands.recv; admission clears the React input (harness-view.tsx:205), but stopping accounts only for self.deferred. Account for pending operator work independently of export/save flags and include its truthful unsent status in durable history. Acceptance: stop with a queued next message and release a valid export during the grace period; the final visible and offline entries must match exactly. Cover renewal-carried prompts and cancellation before channel consumption as well, with no automatic replay. A successful export may remain a restore point for completed turns, but must never replay the unsent message.

P06-R3-F2 (high): Re-check stop/context authority before releasing deferred work after an asynchronous save. In crates/desktop-core/src/harness/session.rs:1006-1009, drive awaits save and then unconditionally executes self.deferred. End/Sleep/retirement can cancel the conversation while the blocking history sink is outstanding; stopping is set only after the next select enters finish_export (:986-987, :1023). On save completion, deferred Send therefore queues a fresh turn/start before cancellation is observed. write_frames (:857-868) drains that frame without checking cancellation, so a new Gateway inference can begin after stop or retirement. Deferred Renew similarly bypasses the next cancellation select and can request another engine launch. The new stopping guard in the export-refusal arm does not cover this success/save path. Acceptance: queue the next message behind a held export, let the valid export enter a held history write, initiate stop, then release the write. Observe zero additional turn/start frames, Gateway requests or engine restarts, and preserve the unsent message. Exercise the renewal variant too; cancelled work must remain cancelled across every await before dispatch.
evidence_gaps: P06-R3-G1: The new a_stop_while_an_export_fails_keeps_the_turn_and_sends_nothing_waiting test covers four refusal/malformed combinations and passes, but excludes a successful delayed export with queued work, cancellation during an outstanding save, deferred Renew and a command still awaiting consumption. The real-engine successful-export test queues no next message. Add deterministic production-interface regressions for the two findings, using export/write barriers and engine-frame or remote-request counts, plus exact offline transcript comparison and reconnect no-replay checks. Existing hold_history_writes/history_writes_under_way helpers provide a save barrier.
limitations: Independent read-only cumulative re-review. No application/source edits, test/build reruns, engine/application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. The remaining findings follow directly from production control flow; they are not claimed as newly executed runtime reproductions. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.

All four supplied fingerprints independently match at the beginning and end. Verified 689 source inventory entries, 72 direct packet references, recorded logs/artifacts, dependency and shared-input equivalence, exact phase command plans and 29 transitive receipt bindings including passing P01-P05. The P05 base commit and full-pass C19-C22 completions match the ledger without owner acceptance or invalidation. Reconstructed attempt-02 source from its frozen patch, verified its hashes and inspected all eight changed inputs.

The attempt-02 refusal/malformed drain defects are addressed: stopping prevents that failure arm from releasing deferred work, and unsaved survives export errors so completed turns are sealed inspect-only. The new regression and its three mutation guards support those fixes. Remaining defects concern successful saves and pending-message accounting across stop, rather than reopening the already-fixed refusal/malformed cases.

Earlier grant isolation, protected-storage fencing, tool cancellation, complete approvals, proposals, MCP scope/expiry and open-turn persistence fixes remain intact in the surrounding implementation.
